applycleaner.description: Applies the selected cleaner to the provided text.
applycleaner.static.description: Applies the selected cleaner to the provided text.
find.regex.description: Finds and replaces specified text using regular expressions.
find.delete.description: Finds specified text and deletes it.
find.assignlinks.description: Finds provided text and associates a hyperlinked URL to that text.
find.batch.regex: Regex Find and Replace with List
find.batch.description: Find and Replace using specified list values.
text.wrap.description: Rewraps specified text using the indicated maximum line length.
text.quote.description: Rewraps text using the selected maximum line length, placing quote characters as appropriate.
text.tag.description: Wraps the selected text in a prefix and suffix of text. Useful for tagging HTML or XML text.
text.delete.description: Deletes the provided text. Use with a conditional statement to remove matched text.
text.appendtoclip.description: Append the provided text on the clipboard.
text.pastefromclip.description: Set the provided text to the contents of the clipboard.
text.performservice.description: Perform named OS X Service on provided text.
line.addto.description: Add specified text to each line.
line.removefrom.description: Remove specified text from the beginning of each line.
text.extract.description: Extracts text matching the provided regular expression.
style.text.font.description: Applies font family, face, size attributes to the text.
style.text.exactfont.description: Applies specific font name, size to the text.
style.text.adjustsize.description: Provides relative adjustments to the font size of the text.
style.text.color.description: Set text color of the text.
style.text.backcolor.description: Set background color of the text.
style.text.underline.description: Set underline options of the text.
style.text.strikethru.description: Set strikethrough options of the text.
style.text.superscript.description: Set text as superscript, subscript, or no script.
style.attribute.remove.description: Finds and removes the specified character attribute from text.
text.titlecase.description: Capitalizes words for title case but allows specifying additional small words (which are always lowercase) as well as exception words (which are ignored).
text.hyperlinks2text.description: Converts rich text hyperlinks to text.
text.substring.description: Extracts specified number of characters from text.
if.match.date.description: Finds any dates using Apple's Data Detector.
if.match.url.description: Finds any URLS using Apple's Data Detector
if.match.text.description: Finds provided text then applies contained actions to it.
if.match.font.description: Finds text matching specific font, size, color attributes, then applies contained actions to it.
if.match.attribute.description: Finds text matching specified attribute, then applies contained actions to it.
if.match.text.processlines.description: Perform specified actions on each line specified.
if.end.description: Marks the end of a conditional block.
modify.results.invert.description: Inverts the selected text of the this condition.
modify.results.limit.description: Set the maximum matches for this condition.
modify.results.skip.description: Ignore the specified matches for this condition.
line.sort.description: Sorts the selected lines in either ascending or descending order.
line.loop.description: Loop through each line, allowing each specified line to be processed separately
runtime.macrolist.description: Placed at the top level, specifies named groups which should be considered macros (containing collections of actions). Can be applied with 'Apply Macro' action.
runtime.macro.description: Defines a macro (collection of actions) that you apply using 'Apply Macro' action.
runtime.applymacro.description: Applies the defined Macro to the current text.
runtime.group.description: Container to organize actions within a cleaner.
runtime.repeat.description: Repeat contained items using the rules provided.
runtime.definelist.description: Defines a list that can be used with Find & Replace
runtime.usernote.description: Allows user to specify notes within a cleaner.
runtime.workflow.description: This action runs an Automator Workflow (located in the ~/Library/Application Support/TextSoap/Workflows folder).
runtime.javascript.description: Applies the provided Javascript on the provided text.
runtime.processlist.description: Loop through each row and apply contained cleaners.
runtime.askuser.description: Define a Variable by Asking User
